# AuraPalm - Vedic Chiromancy & AI Palm Reading Online India

> AuraPalm is India's premier Vedic Chiromancy (हस्तरेखा शास्त्र) and AI-driven palmistry platform. We combine ancient Samudrika Shastra algorithms with biometric palm scanning and live consultations from verified master astrologers across India.

## Key Features
- **Free AI Palm Scanner**: Real-time biometric scanning for male and female hands, detecting Heart, Head, Life, Fate, and Sun lines.
- **Bilingual Experience**: Full dual-language support in English and Hindi (हिन्दी).
- **Vedic Chiromancy Knowledgebase**: Exhaustive guides on mounts (Jupiter, Saturn, Apollo, Mercury, Venus, Mars, Moon) and auspicious yogas (Gaj Kesari, Raj Yoga, Simhasan Yoga).
- **Certified Master Palmists**: 1-on-1 consultations starting at ₹499 INR with verified Vedic chiromancers.
- **Personalized Kundali & Palm Reports**: Downloadable detailed karmic and career destiny dossiers.
